comparison.objective: Candidate calibrates and locks a gripper opening stop; PR-984 centers an inside-bolt-circle gasket between flanges and inserts four bolts.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate emphasizes coaxial tool seating, wrench regrasping, and countertorque; PR-984 emphasizes planar gasket insertion and centering in a constrained gap followed by repeated bolt-through-hole placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires locked angle retention and repeatable close-open cycles; PR-984 requires the gasket centered and flat, the upper flange undisturbed, all four bolts seated through both flanges, release, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Gasket alignment and multi-bolt insertion do not exercise coupled adjustment-and-locking reaction control; the absence of modeled threads or torque in PR-984 further separates the tested ability, and its rubric is detailed.
